title: Rotini Configuration Schema
description: Schema for a Rotini CLI configuration file.

$schema.description: URL identifying the rotini configuration schema version. The version segment must match the installed rotini binary version.

InitializeConfig.description: Defaults for `rotini init`, read from the .rotini.conf.* at the module root when present. A project without such a conf gets rotini's built-in defaults. Explicit `rotini init` flags override these.

format.description: Serialization for the spec/conf files scaffolded by `rotini init` when run without an explicit --format. Default "yaml".

package.description: Directory under the module root where `rotini init` creates new CLIs (each new CLI becomes a Go package beneath it). Default "cmd".

ValidateConfig.description: Controls how `rotini validate` reports problems. Strictness is fixed (validation is always strict); only the failure-reporting mode is configurable. The `--fail` flag overrides this.

fail.description: fast = stop at and report the first problem; collect = run to completion and report every problem at once (default).

GenerateRthConfig.description: The rth (handler) package: the per-command handler stubs and the generated rollup. Stubs that no longer correspond to a command are pruned every pass (implicit/always-on); list package-relative paths under 'keep' to spare hand-written files.

package.description: Import path (relative to module root) for the handler package. Package name is derived from the last path segment.

file.description: Name of the rotini-controlled rollup file placed in the handler package (e.g. 'handlers.go'). Must end in .go.

keep.description: Package-relative paths (e.g. 'helpers.go') that pruning must never remove, even when they do not correspond to a command in the spec. Intended to stay empty in steady state.

GenerateRtgConfig.description: The rtg (framework) package: the generated framework file plus any rendered feature outputs (help, and — later — man/markdown/completion). Orphaned rendered outputs are pruned every pass (implicit/always-on); list package-relative paths under 'keep' to spare files.

package.description: Import path (relative to module root) for the framework package. Package name is derived from the last path segment.

file.description: Name of the rotini-controlled framework file placed in the framework package (e.g. 'rotini.go'). Must end in .go.

keep.description: Package-relative paths (e.g. 'help/legacy.txt') that pruning must never remove. The editable per-feature template (e.g. 'help/help.txt.tmpl') and test files are always kept automatically. Intended to stay empty in steady state.

FeaturesConfig.description: Rendered/derived codegen features generated into the rtg package. Each shares one contract: a toggle, a rotini-managed output dir, an editable per-feature template (for the doc-rendered features), a per-command verbatim spec escape, and an embedded var + resolver in the rtg file.

help.description: Embedded, per-command help text. When enabled, rotini produces a per-command help .txt for every command and embeds them in the rtg package as 'Help<Prefix>' string vars plus a 'Help(path ...string) (string, error)' resolver. Each .txt is rotini-managed: when a command sets a verbatim 'help' string in the spec it is written exactly; otherwise the page is rendered from the command's structured help fields (summary/description/usage/...) via the editable help template in the feature's dir.

man.description: Embedded, per-command man pages. Same render-or-verbatim contract as help: each command's .txt is rendered from its doc-fields through the editable man template in the feature's dir, or written verbatim when the command sets a 'man' string in the spec. Emits 'Man<Prefix>' vars plus a 'Man(path ...string) (string, error)' resolver.

markdown.description: Embedded, per-command markdown pages (e.g. for a docs site). Same render-or-verbatim contract as help, via the editable markdown template in the feature's dir or a command's verbatim 'markdown' string. Emits 'Markdown<Prefix>' vars plus a 'Markdown(path ...string) (string, error)' resolver.

completion.description: Embedded shell completion scripts — the features group's exception: generated per supported shell (bash/zsh/fish) from the program name, not per command, with no doc-data, no editable template, and no verbatim escape. Emits 'Completion<Shell>' vars plus a 'Completion(shell string) (string, error)' resolver; a handler reads rtg.Completion(shell) instead of importing rtk.

Feature.description: A rendered/derived codegen feature: a toggle plus the output subdirectory under the rtg package.

enabled.description: When true, rotini generates this feature's outputs into the rtg package and emits the embed vars + resolver. Opt-in only.

dir.description: Subdirectory under the rtg package where this feature's rotini-managed output files (and, for the doc-rendered features, the editable template) live and are embedded. Defaults to the feature name (e.g. 'help').
